name: Grants Resource Access
description: A role's allow rules reach this protected resource: its `*_labels` selectors match the resource's labels and no deny rule of the same role excludes it. Derived, not declared by Teleport; the property says how, so a view can tell label-matched from wildcard access.

principals.description: What the grant lets its holder be on the resource: SSH logins, Kubernetes groups, database users, Windows logins. Empty when the role grants the resource but names no principal.

match.description: `labels` when a specific selector matched; `wildcard` when the selector was `'*': '*'`.
